Item Class: Skill Gems
Rarity: Gem
Molten Strike
--------
Attack, Projectile, AoE, Melee, Strike, Fire
Level: 4
Cost: 6 Mana
Attack Damage: 146% of base
Effectiveness of Added Damage: 146%
--------
Requirements:
Level: 7
Str: 22
--------
Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.
--------
Fires 4 Projectiles
60% of Physical Damage Converted to Fire Damage
Projectiles deal 60% less Damage with Hits and Ailments
--------
Experience: 6667/6667
--------
Next-level requirements:
Level: 11
Str: 31
--------
Place into an item socket to gain this skill. Right click to remove from a socket.
